aiView.textExcerpt: About One place to find paid AI training work. Artificial Jobs lists hourly roles where domain experts help AI labs improve their models. Open roles 307 Fields 19 Median top rate $90/hr Top hourly rate $400/hr AI labs pay lawyers, doctors, engineers, scientists and linguists to write, review and grade the examples their models learn from. The work is real and often well paid, but it’s scattered across job posts that are hard to compare. Artificial Jobs collects those roles into one list, ranked by pay and grouped by profession, so you can see what your expertise is worth before you apply. The site is run by Keating Holdings . We don’t employ anyone listed here and we don’t run the hiring process: applications, interviews and payment all happen on micro1. How listings work Sourced from micro1 Every role comes from micro1’s public job feed. We pull the full description, pay range, location and remote status from each role’s own micro1 job page. Refreshed daily An automated job re-checks every listing once a day. Roles micro1 closes are removed, and their pages redirect to the field they belonged to. Ranked by pay Roles are ordered by the top of their hourly pay range, newest first on ties. Pay figures are the ranges micro1 publishes; we don’t estimate or adjust them. Grouped by field Each role is filed under the field micro1 assigns it (Law, Medicine, Software Engineering and so on), plus credential pages such as PhDs and physicians matched on the role’s title and skills. How we get paid Apply links on these roles include our micro1 referral code. Artificial Jobs may earn a referral fee if you’re hired, at no cost to you. Referral fees don’t affect ranking: every role is ordered by pay, and every listing carries the same referral code. We also refer companies to AI data partnerships.
